snippet.title: Coke Studio Nu.WAV Session ft Asim Azhar
snippet.description:
Asim Azhar (@asimazhar) sits down with a group of young musicians for an honest conversation on chasing your own sound, staying rooted in where you come from, and writing unique melodies that stick.

Artists: 
Amaan Kashif (@amaan.kashif47)
Zain Darban (@zaindarban)
Sameer Hamza (@imsameerhamza)
Waj
